_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: Hi pookie, I made this to write to you while youre away. I love you more than anything in the whole world.

I cannot promise to love you perfectly, but i can promise to love you endlessly. I have loved you through every version of us and every life we've never lived. Even the stars burn until nothing remains, but I love you endlessly.
